title: Recording: Dear Boy, Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eirik Wangberg

Paul and Linda McCartney finished recording the Ram songs ‘Dear Boy’ and ‘Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey’ on 7 April 1971.

On 1 April they had enlisted electronic musician Paul Beaver to add synthesizer effects to ‘Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey’, although the results were deemed unsatisfactory. He returned on this day, adding underwater sounds to the song, plus and phasing effects to ‘Dear Boy’.

Studio engineer Eirik Wangberg also added storm effects to the ‘Uncle Albert’ section, and the song was finally ready to be mixed.

Page last updated: 13 November 2025
